messages:
maria: Hey team — Horizon Systems asked for a Dedicated POC. They need a small reserved pool but with burstability for demo spikes. Main asks: H100 vs A100, eu-central region (data residency), VPC peering + customer KMS, and a rough price + ETA. Can infra advise capacity and any legal blockers?

devin: Thanks Maria. Quick context: expected steady throughput ~40 rps, median seq 512, occasional long runs to 2048 for hallucination tests. They'll run 3 concurrent model variants.

eli: @maria @devin rough guidance: for that profile i'd suggest 4 x H100 for baseline (low latency <50ms p50 for seq512) or 6 x A100 if they want cheaper per-hour but higher latency. H100 gives better perf for long sequences. Need to confirm instance SKU w/ cloud partner.

maria: They prefer eu-central-1. Any capacity constraints there? Also they want burst to 8 GPUs during demos.

eli: eu-central has limited immediate H100 capacity this week. We can do A100 instantly. H100 can be scheduled within 7-10 business days or we can provide a hybrid: Dedicated with A100 steady, H100 as burst in another region with routing fallback — but that adds cross-region routing complexity and data residency flags.

rachel: Legal check: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS is OK but we need the SOC config and AAD/SAML SSO attachments for the control plane. Also need the customer to sign our data processing addendum before we enable cross-region replication or any route that leaves eu.

maria: Noted. I'll ask Horizon for signed DPA and SOC contact. If they insist H100 in eu only, timeline becomes the blocker.

devin: Can we show them a pricing estimate? Put both options: 4xH100 reserved vs 6xA100 reserved, plus burst pricing. Also include network egress and private link setup fees.

eli: I'll draft numbers. Example provisioning payload I can use for the request:
```
{
  "customer": "horizon-systems",
  "region": "eu-central-1",
  "pool": {
    "steady_gpus": 4,
    "burst_gpus": 8,
    "preferred_sku": "H100",
    "fallback_sku": "A100",
    "is_vpc_peered": true
  },
  "kms": "customer-managed",
  "sla": "72h-setup"
}
```

eli: For timeline assume: A100 in 2 business days; H100 in eu ~7–10 business days if partner quota approved. If they sign commitment (monthly), we can prioritize.

sam: From product: please flag model quantization needs — if they plan INT8 we can suggest a mixed-sku pool to lower cost. Also, alerting/trace setup for POC should be pre-wired so they can see token-level cost.

maria: Good point. I'll capture quantization ask.

rachel: Also need to confirm whether customer requires dedicated audit log retention and how long. That may be an add-on.

maria: Action items: 1) I will get DPA + SOC contact + retention requirements from Horizon. 2) @eli to post a short price/timeline matrix for 4xH100 vs 6xA100 + burst options. 3) @sam to add monitoring / quantization checklist to the POC playbook. 4) I'll loop back once DPA is in.

eli: Copy. I'll post numbers in this thread by EOD.

sre-bot: Deploy ticket created: PROV-8921 — Dedicated pool request queued (region: eu-central-1). ETA depends on SKU availability.

maria: Thanks all — please keep updates here. :thumbsup:
